_comment: Creative-engine enforcement rules for Castille Academy. Mirrors the Athletes Acceleration ruleset (same youth-sports-performance creative contract) so a repurposed AA campaign validates under Castille identically to its source. Consumed by scripts/validate-plan.mjs via loadRules(); without this file the brand falls back to DEFAULT_RULES, which is stricter (no mediaExempt) and false-flags motion stat-reveal/logo-sting cards. eyebrowPattern stays '{CITY} SPORT PARENTS' so the Pelham eyebrow ('PELHAM SPORT PARENTS') parses.
_beatRolesNote: anyOf = the beat's VALID role set; an asset must carry >=1.
